title: Migrate Struktur Documentation to Fumadocs
description: Set up Fumadocs in documentation/ directory, convert existing HTML docs to MDX, and configure static export to docs/ for GitHub Pages deployment. The homepage design must remain pixel-perfect.

overview.current_state: Raw HTML documentation in docs/ directory with custom styling, already organized by Diátaxis framework (tutorials, how-to, reference, explanation)
overview.target_state: Fumadocs-based documentation site in documentation/ that builds to docs/ for GitHub Pages
key_requirements: Homepage (docs/index.html) design stays EXACTLY the same - pixel perfect preservation
Documentation pages converted from HTML to MDX and rendered with Fumadocs
Output builds to docs/ directory for GitHub Pages deployment
Preserve all content, code examples, mermaid diagrams, and navigation structure
Maintain Diátaxis organization (tutorials, how-to guides, explanation, reference)

homepage.notes: Complex landing page with terminal animation, strategy tabs, mermaid diagrams, and custom dark theme. Must be preserved exactly as-is in a custom Next.js page.

redirects.note: Simple redirect page, can be handled by Next.js redirect config or meta.json

installation.notes: This will create the documentation/ directory with Next.js + Fumadocs

search.static_export_config: Configure Orama for static export per Fumadocs docs

homepage_strategy.rationale: The existing docs/index.html is a complex landing page with: terminal typing animation, interactive strategy tabs with mermaid diagrams, dark theme with custom CSS properties, grid-based layout with border styling, hover effects and transitions. Replicating this exactly in Fumadocs MDX would be nearly impossible. Instead, preserve the exact HTML/CSS/JS by converting to a React/Next.js page.

implementation.method: Convert docs/index.html to a Next.js page component preserving all styles and scripts
steps: Copy the HTML structure from docs/index.html
Move inline styles to CSS modules or preserve in style tags
Convert terminal animation script to useEffect hooks
Convert strategy tab switching to React state
Preserve all CSS custom properties and keyframe animations

critical_elements: All Tailwind @theme configurations from the style tag

scripts.terminal_animation: Convert to React hooks - typing animation in useEffect
scripts.strategy_tabs: Convert to React useState for tab switching, update mermaid renders
scripts.mermaid: Initialize on client side with dark theme using useEffect

process: Extract main content from HTML files (strip doc-app wrapper, sidebar, theme toggle)
Convert HTML tags to MDX/markdown syntax
Preserve code blocks with proper language annotations (ts, bash, json, mermaid)
Convert tables to markdown table syntax
Add frontmatter with title and description to each MDX file
Convert callout divs to Fumadocs <Callout> components

mdx_components.code_blocks: Use standard markdown code fences with language
mdx_components.mermaid: Use ```mermaid code blocks - configure Fumadocs to render these
mdx_components.callouts: Use Fumadocs <Callout> component for highlighted notes

navigation_structure.diataxis_preservation: Keep the existing Diátaxis organization - this maps perfectly to Fumadocs navigation

github_pages.setup: Configure GitHub Pages to serve from docs/ directory on main branch
github_pages.cname: Preserve docs/CNAME file - copy it to output

preserve: docs/assets/style.css - if referenced by custom pages

implementation_steps.details: Choose Next.js template with Fumadocs MDX. This creates the documentation/ directory.

implementation_steps.action: Update next.config.mjs to export static build to ../docs

implementation_steps.task: Set up homepage as custom page
implementation_steps.action: Create custom Next.js page with exact HTML/CSS/JS from docs/index.html
implementation_steps.details: This is critical - the homepage must look pixel-perfect. Convert the HTML to React, preserve all styles and animations.

implementation_steps.action: Set up Fumadocs layouts for documentation pages
implementation_steps.details: Keep the homepage as its own thing, use Fumadocs layout for /docs/* routes

implementation_steps.action: Define sidebar navigation matching Diátaxis structure
implementation_steps.structure: Tutorials, How-to Guides, Explanation, Reference sections

implementation_steps.action: Extract content from HTML files, convert to MDX format
implementation_steps.details: Strip the doc-app wrapper (sidebar, etc), keep only the doc-content. Add frontmatter, convert to MDX syntax.
Fumadocs supports mermaid via MDX components. Configure for dark theme to match existing.

implementation_steps.action: Set up Orama search with static export configuration
implementation_steps.details: Follow Fumadocs guide for static export search setup
Build the site, verify output in docs/ directory. Check all pages render correctly.

implementation_steps.action: Ensure docs/CNAME is copied to output, preserve other needed assets
implementation_steps.details: After build, ensure CNAME file exists in docs/. Copy any needed assets from old docs/assets/.
Test the site locally to ensure homepage looks perfect and docs pages work

must_preserve: Dark theme color scheme (#0b0e12 background, #f5f7fb text, #3ddc97 accent)
Strategy tabs with mermaid flowchart diagrams
All sections: hero, features, examples, use cases, integrations, articles, footer
All code examples with syntax highlighting
Dark mode support for docs pages

homepage_conversion.html_to_react: Convert the static HTML to React components
homepage_conversion.scripts_to_hooks: Convert terminal animation and tab switching to React useEffect/useState
homepage_conversion.styles: Preserve all CSS custom properties and animations. Can use style tag in component or CSS modules.
homepage_conversion.mermaid: Initialize mermaid in useEffect with dark theme
homepage_conversion.links: Update internal links to use Next.js Link component or proper relative paths for static export

mdx_conversion.html_stripping: Remove the doc-app wrapper, sidebar, and theme toggle from HTML - Fumadocs provides these
mdx_conversion.content_extraction: Extract just the doc-content div content
mdx_conversion.syntax_highlighting: Fumadocs has built-in syntax highlighting via rehype-prism-plus
mdx_conversion.mermaid: Use ```mermaid code blocks, configure Fumadocs MDX to handle these
mdx_conversion.tables: Convert HTML tables to markdown tables
mdx_conversion.callouts: Convert HTML callout divs to <Callout> components

fumadocs_specifics.layouts: Use Fumadocs DocsLayout for docs pages, custom for homepage
fumadocs_specifics.search: Orama search with static export requires special config
fumadocs_specifics.static_export: Builds to distDir, trailingSlash recommended for GitHub Pages

success_criteria: Homepage looks pixel-perfect identical to original docs/index.html
All documentation pages render correctly with Fumadocs UI
Navigation structure matches Diátaxis organization (tutorials, how-to, explanation, reference)
All code examples have syntax highlighting
Dark mode works for both homepage and docs pages
Build output in docs/ directory works on GitHub Pages
CNAME file preserved for custom domain
